description: Local MCP server that generates images (via OpenRouter) and saves them as PNG files.
name: io.github.LukasMomot/image-generation-mcp

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenRouter API key used to generate images.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GEN_DEFAULT_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model used when the tool call does not specify one. Defaults to openai/gpt-image-2.5-flare.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GEN_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where generated PNG files are saved. Defaults to ./output (relative to the working directory).
